name: Anapoima (Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of yellow and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Anapoima (a sun rising over a river, with the motto ETERNA JUVENTUD).
history: Municipal flag of Anapoima, a municipality in the department of Cundinamarca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Anapoima arms — sun rising over a river, with motto ETERNA JUVENTUD
